verse.verse_1: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;
verse.verse_2: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
verse.verse_3: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?
verse.verse_4: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.
verse.verse_5: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
verse.verse_6: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
verse.verse_7: At length, when the sight is dazed,
verse.verse_8: And the moon is buried in darkness.
verse.verse_9: And the sun and moon are joined together,-
verse.verse_10: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"
verse.verse_11: By no means! No place of safety!
verse.verse_12: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.
verse.verse_13: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.
verse.verse_14: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,
verse.verse_15: Even though he were to put up his excuses.
verse.verse_16: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.
verse.verse_17: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
verse.verse_18: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
verse.verse_19: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):
verse.verse_20: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,
verse.verse_22: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
verse.verse_24: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,
verse.verse_25: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;
verse.verse_26: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),
verse.verse_27: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"
verse.verse_28: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;
verse.verse_29: And one leg will be joined with another:
verse.verse_30: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!
verse.verse_31: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-
verse.verse_32: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!
verse.verse_33: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!
verse.verse_34: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
verse.verse_35: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
verse.verse_36: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?
verse.verse_37: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
verse.verse_38: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.
verse.verse_39: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.
verse.verse_40: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
